claim_summary: Dataset comprises 349 recordings across 329 annotated patients (307 AF+), 10,952.98h known annotated rhythm, and 8,540 canonical runs (vs 379 raw recs / 11,701.45h).
reconciled_evidence: Rebuilt from WFDB/HDF5/parquet: 379 raw / 349 annotated / 30 unannotated recs; 358 raw / 329 ann / 307 AF+ pts; 10952.98h known / 11701.45h raw; 8540 canonical runs (retires erroneous 8,582 figure).

claim_summary: Brief AF runs (<30s) dominate episode count (58.7%, 5,016/8,540) while prolonged runs (>=30m) dominate AF time (94.15%, 553/8,540), heavily heterogeneous by cohort.
reconciled_evidence: LTAFDB has 7,358 runs (4,704 <30s; 202 >=30m), SHDB-AF has 794 runs (310 <30s; 102 >=30m), IRIDIA-AF has 388 runs (only 2 <30s; 249 >=30m). Cross-cohort comparison requires annotation harmonization.

claim_summary: Brief AF runs cluster after prolonged AF termination predominantly over pre-onset boundaries (Post [0,+5]m RR=4.82, Post/Pre RR=2.59, p<1e-7; Null A p<0.001 in 87.4% pts).
reconciled_evidence: Actual GEE on 304 LTAFDB+SHDB index episodes shows bilateral boundary clustering in risk-time (Pre vs Remote RR=6.24, p=1.59e-07; Post vs Remote RR=4.39, p=7.57e-05) with NO post-predominance (Post vs Pre RR=0.70, p=0.176). Null A Obs/Exp in LTAFDB is 0.905 Pre / 0.674 Post; Null B p<0.05 in 0.0% recordings.

source_report: V7 E01 Risk-Time vs Physical-Time Audit
claim_summary: Brief AF clustering near prolonged AF episodes persists across non-AF risk time in both LTAFDB and SHDB-AF and survives top-10 prolific LTAFDB patient exclusions, but attenuates to NS under pooled physical time.
classification: 2. Supported only in a restricted population
reconciled_evidence: Risk-time Pre RR=6.24 rises to 10.32 (p=7.07e-16) after excluding top-10 LTAFDB patients. However, pooled physical-time Pre RR=1.86 (p=0.102) is non-significant, driven by LTAFDB occupancy distortion; SHDB-AF alone is positive in both risk-time (~18.1x) and physical-time (~11.1x).

claim_summary: Within-episode HR accelerates +10.1 bpm and CVRR compresses 24.8% -> 17.6% over first 15m; historical density explains +7.2% R^2 in ventricular trajectory (M3->M4) and +0.0597 GAM deviance.
reconciled_evidence: Matched longitudinal panel surviving to 32.5m (n=509 episodes) shows HR slightly decreases (97.29 -> 95.82 bpm) and flat CVRR (0.2173 -> 0.2133). M3->M4 R^2 delta is 0.01725->0.01927 (+0.20 pp, p=0.280), within-patient p=0.984. Patient-disjoint 5-fold OOF GAM R^2 density delta is +0.00161 (0.33308->0.33470); pooled Cox PH density HR=1.1382 (p=0.514).

claim_summary: Charitos density predicts larger LAD (+3.84 mm per +0.10 density, p=0.019) and separates LAD in N=38 <1% burden patients (43.8 vs 38.4 mm, p=0.038).
reconciled_evidence: Across all 16 patient-deduplicated LAD/LVEF regressions (<=30d, <=90d, <=180d, Unrestricted), ALL 95% B=2,000 CIs cross zero (e.g. PAF Multi-Run <=90d n=17: +0.188 mm, 95% CI [-2.298, +2.270], p=0.821). Only 13 AF+ patients have <1% 12h burden in annotated SHDB (49 total includes 36 zero-AF recordings).

claim_summary: P01 contains 1,842 landmarks (14.8% prev); density improves P01 by +0.054 and P02 by +0.057; X12 achieves 0.842 AUROC; SetOperator G1 reaches 0.814 P01 / 0.738 C-index P03; B=2,000 used in ablations.
reconciled_evidence: Raw P01 manifest has 98,404 rows (90,057 clean annotated, prev 1.872%, 300 pts; 8,347 unannotated rows leaked in raw). Fixed-model matched contrasts (B=2,000): P01 DensityOnly vs Arch Delta=+0.0060 (p=0.436); P02 DensityOnly vs Arch Delta=+0.0012 (p=0.467); P03 DensityOnly vs Arch Delta=+0.0005 (p=0.665). Original run_13stage_ablations.py used n_bootstrap=500.

claim_summary: Episode architecture (S2) outperforms scalar burden (S1) for early persistence (P02) and dynamic survival (P03), without future leakage.
reconciled_evidence: Leakage audit confirms 0.0 feature diff across 150 adversarial future-deletion tests. On P02 (n=2,458, 290 pts), S2 vs S1 logistic Delta=+0.0742 (95% CI [+0.0463, +0.1009], p=0.0010); remains strong within LTAFDB (0.8664), IRIDIA (0.7173), and LOCO transfer (0.8548 / 0.7664 / 0.7283), though within-patient equal-episode discrimination (n=91 pts) is near chance (0.4789 logistic / 0.5245 lgbm).

claim_summary: Instantaneous RR dynamics boost imminent sustained-AF forecasting (P01) even after stripping the IRIDIA is_rr_valid cohort shortcut, though clinical alert performance remains weak.
classification: 2. Supported only in a restricted population
reconciled_evidence: Strictly within LTAFDB+SHDB ValidRR without is_rr_valid shortcut, CleanRR boosts P01 LGBM from 0.5710 to 0.6689 (Delta=+0.0979, 95% CI [+0.0546, +0.1406], p=0.0010; Logistic +0.0345, p=0.073). However, clean P01 alert sensitivity at thr=0.05 is only 9.79%-10.14% at 14.6-16.6 warnings/patient-day.

claim_summary: Noise Holter: P04 conventional RR AUROC is 0.4125, beat_coverage > 1.0 reflects missingness, and FM embeddings add broad clinical prognosis gains.
reconciled_evidence: 0.4125 was an all-NaN F4 extraction bug; real RR features achieve 0.9023 LGBM (0.8419 Logistic). beat_coverage is actually detected/expected beats at 60bpm (mean 1.010 Clean -> 1.565 N2). Automated waveform SQI detects N2 at 0.9242 AUROC and matches oracle abstention at 79.4% coverage (0.9641 vs 0.9666). Only ECGFounder (+0.379 AUROC gain over random-init) and EchoNext (+0.052) beat random-init weights on P04; F2 (+0.007) and CSFM (-0.004) do not.

claim_summary: Density is highly robust to short-episode omission and <60s gap bridging (MAE 0.00110 in IRIDIA+SHDB simulation).
classification: 2. Supported only in a restricted population
reconciled_evidence: In LTAFDB (n=83 density-defined recs), gap bridging <60s yields MAE=0.06933 (max=0.7459), rising to MAE=0.11443 among n=26 patients with >=20 brief (<30s) runs (>100x larger than in prolonged-dominant IRIDIA+SHDB).

claim_summary: High Charitos density conceals a 30-fold spread in transition instability across existing continuous cohorts; longitudinal stroke/cardiopathy outcomes remain absent.
reconciled_evidence: Among 118 independent multi-run patients with high Charitos density (>=0.80, median 0.9752), 55 have 2-5 runs (4.06 transitions/24h) while 29 have >=20 runs (122.61 transitions/24h, median 61 runs). Stroke/AF progression endpoints do not exist in IRIDIA-AF/LTAFDB/SHDB-AF, so clinical stroke confounding cannot be answered here.

claim_summary: Adding frozen FM embeddings to canonical tabular history/density (S3c) improves longitudinal prediction (P01/P02/P03) under fixed models.
classification: 2. Supported only in a restricted population
reconciled_evidence: Fixed-model matched evaluation (B=2,000): on P01_CleanAnnotated (which lacks F4 RR in S3c), ECGFOUNDER fusion yields +0.0281 logistic (0.6125->0.6406, 95% CI [+0.0046, +0.0527], p=0.0150; still below CleanRR 0.6686/0.6689). On P02_Persistence60s & P03_Survival15m logistic models, all FMs are null or significantly worse (P02 ECHONEXT Delta=-0.0074, p=0.0010; F2 Delta=-0.0047, p=0.010). LGBM P03 gains (+0.0089 ECGFOUNDER) only partly recover LGBM lag (0.8710 vs Logistic 0.8807). FMs dominate P04 morphology/noise (ECGFOUNDER 0.9453 PCA-32 / 0.9578 full), not longitudinal prognosis.

claim_summary: IRIDIA-AF scarcity of <30s runs (only 2/388 runs vs 4,704/7,358 in LTAFDB) represents pure atrial biology rather than annotation-protocol/minimum-duration filtering.
reconciled_evidence: Annotation minimum-duration criteria in IRIDIA-AF HDF5 generation cannot be retrospectively verified from WFDB/HDF5 files alone; harmonization sensitivity bounds are required.
